title: Ad Hooks for Local Businesses: 10 Examples That Work
description: Ad hooks that stop the scroll in two seconds: 10 hook formulas with ready-to-use examples for local trades, driving schools, food and services.
dek: An ad hook is the first line or first two seconds of your ad. The ones that work for local businesses name a specific problem, mention the local area, show a real result, or say something surprising.

faq.a: An ad hook is the first line or first two seconds of your ad, the part that decides whether someone keeps watching or scrolls past. A strong hook matters more than polished production.

faq.q: Which ad hooks work best for local businesses?
